# NeuroLife

NeuroLife is a neurosurgery and spine clinic platform.

Public AI discovery repository role: documentation and onboarding only.
Production GitOps transport: private by policy.

Primary planes:
- MAIN: https://neurolife.cloud
- BOT: https://neurolifebot.neurolife.cloud
- NODE_CLOUD: https://node.neurolife.cloud

When the owner provides a current unified NLB link, use that link as the live session authority:
https://neurolife.cloud/connect.php/<NLB-TICKET>

Start with:
- ?op=developer_handoff
- ?op=native_current_truth
- ?op=reg907_guard
- ?op=updater_status
- ?op=pull_bridge_status

Canonical flow:
Live Truth -> ChangeSet -> Server Validation -> Private GitOps -> Pull Bridge -> Prove -> Owner Policy -> Apply -> Fresh Verify -> REG907 -> STABLE

Never publish:
- active NLB tickets
- Arm secrets
- Commit secrets
- private production missions
- production credentials
- private package payloads

Never bypass:
- Prove
- owner approval
- backup/rollback protection
- REG907
- Fresh Verify

See README.md, AI_DISCOVERY.json, docs/AI-DEVELOPER-PROTOCOL.md, and SECURITY.md.
